title: Onboard sylph-13b-v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and automate changelog
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Add the new open Sylph 13B v1.0 model to the registry with complete metadata, performance profiles for our standard GPU types, and wire up changelog/release-note automation so future releases of this model surface correctly. This PR includes: 1) model metadata YAML (name, architectures, tokenizer, checkpoints, license) and uploader/ownership fields; 2) auto-generated performance profiles (p50/p95 latency, throughput for batch sizes) produced by the perf-lab harness and validated against the performance schema; 3) a changelog entry template and automation hook so that when model metadata changes we append a stable changelog entry and surface it in the model catalog UI; 4) a lightweight migration that marks the model compatible with quantized runtimes and adds suggested quantization profile tags. Testing: perf-lab runs attached; we ran the standard onboarding CI (unit tests, lint, registry validators) and an end-to-end smoke test on a staging dedicated pool to validate routing and fallback behavior. Rollback plan: metadata and changelog automation are additive; if we need to revert we will revert the head branch which removes the registry entry and the automation hook. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes to catalog consumers. See release_notes for the user-facing summary.

review_comments: Evan Miller (reviewer): Can we include the tokenizer checksum in metadata to prevent accidental tokenization mismatches?
Priya Shah (author reply): Added tokenizer sha256 and integration test to validate tokenization output across sample prompts.

Marta Liu (reviewer): The perf profiles look good but p95 on T4 is close to the boundary in our SLO. Can you add a note to the profile about expected variability and suggested routing to A100 for latency-critical tiers?
Priya Shah (author reply): Added routing note and a tag suggest_route: a100-latency to the T4 profile; updated release_notes accordingly.
Samuel Ortiz (reviewer): Automation job needs a retry on flakey network pulls; otherwise lgtm.
Priya Shah (author reply): Added exponential backoff (3 retries) and added a flaky-network unit test. Ready for merge.
ci_checks: ci/integration-staging: pass (smoke routing and catalog visibility)
release_notes: Added support for Sylph 13B v1.0: model metadata, validated performance profiles for A100/T4, changelog automation for future releases, and quantization suggestion tags. No breaking changes.
